Algorithm 1 APSP-Recursive
Input: A directed graph G = (V, E)
Output: Shortest distance between all pair of vertices
1: n ← |G.V | . Number of vertices in G
2: m ← |G.E| . Number of edges in G
3: Create a distance matrix D[1, 2, . . . , n][1, 2, . . . , n] of size n × n
4: for each vertex u ∈ G.V do
5: for each vertex v ∈ G.V do
6: D[u][v] ← APSP-Helper(n − 1, u, v) . Weight of a shortest path from vertex u
to vertex v that contains at most n − 1 edges
7: end for
8: end for
9: return D
